subject: SSO/SCIM + service account & IP guardrails — Brightlane onboarding
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir@brightlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Nov 23, 2027 at 09:02 AM
Subject: SSO/SCIM + service account & IP guardrails — Brightlane onboarding

Samir —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. To keep momentum, I attached a concise checklist (SAML-config-checklist.pdf) and put the immediate asks below so we can lock the staging cutover window. Can you confirm the items you can share today?

Key asks:
- SAML: entityID, ACS URL(s), and IdP metadata XML (we can accept a URL or the file).
- SCIM: provisioning admin email and whether provisioning will be push-based with attribute mapping (attach mapping if available).
- IP allowlists: CIDR ranges for staging and prod, and whether they can provide a static egress for API calls.
- Service accounts: planned names (staging vs prod) and whether Brightlane requires HSM-backed keys or allows Redwood-managed ephemeral keys.
- Go-live window: propose Nov 29 (US PST) for a staged cutover; any blockers?

We'd like to have the SAML metadata and at least one SCIM admin before Friday so Engineering can pre-populate mappings and run an end-to-end SSO test in our staging cluster.

Attachments: SAML-config-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai
From: Samir Khan <samir@brightlane.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, Nov 23, 2027 at 10:17 AM
Subject: Re: SSO/SCIM + service account & IP guardrails — Brightlane onboarding

On Tue, Nov 23, 2027 at 09:02 AM Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Samir —
> 
> Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. To keep momentum, I attached a concise checklist (SAML-config-checklist.pdf) and put the immediate asks below so we can lock the staging cutover window. Can you confirm the items you can share today?
> 
> Key asks: ...

Hi Priyom — thanks, appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below and I attached our IdP metadata.

- SAML: attaching brightlane-saml.xml (entityID: https://idp.brightlane.com; ACS: https://app.redwood.com/auth/saml/consume).
- SCIM: we will use push provisioning; admin ops@brightlane.com will be the SCIM admin. We have a rough mapping CSV — attaching after internal cleanup.
- IPs: staging ranges are 10.48.0.0/16 and 34.82.128.0/20 (internal-only for now); production ranges will be shared once infra finalizes NAT.
- Service accounts: we typically prefer vendor-managed keys; we can discuss Redwood-managed ephemeral accounts if needed.
- Nov 29 staging window looks fine from our side — want to keep the window 9–12 PST.

Attaching: brightlane-saml.xml

I'll loop in Brightlane Security if we need formal SOC2 paperwork.

—Samir
Samir Khan
Director, Infrastructure — Brightlane Payments
samir@brightlane.com
From: Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@brightlane.com>
Date: Tue, Nov 23, 2027 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Fwd: SSO/SCIM + service account & IP guardrails — Brightlane onboarding

Monica / Ben —

Samir sent the SAML metadata and gave a tentative staging window (Nov 29, 9–12 PST). Key follow-ups for our side before Friday:

1) Engineering: pre-configure the IdP metadata and add ACS URL for a dry-run test in staging. Ben — can you confirm we have a dedicated staging tenant and a runbook for SSO smoke tests?
2) Service accounts: confirm naming convention and token rotation policy. If Brightlane prefers vendor-managed keys, we need to ensure our ephemeral key option is documented as an alternative for their security team.
3) SCIM: once ops@brightlane.com provides the mapping CSV, we will run attribute sync in a sandbox. Monica — can CS own the coordination for the SCIM confirmation and user sample list?
4) IP allowlist: current staging ranges from Samir are pseudo-prod; ask Neha to confirm if those CIDRs meet our egress rules for staging.

Links: mutual action plan (BRIGHT-2345) — https://docs.redwood.com/mutual-action-plan/BRIGHT-2345

I'll capture answers in the plan. If we get the SCIM admin and mapping CSV today, Eng can test tomorrow.

Thanks,
Priyom
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Nov 23, 2027 at 01:14 PM
Subject: Re: SSO/SCIM + service account & IP guardrails — Brightlane onboarding

On Tue, Nov 23, 2027 at 11:03 AM Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Monica / Ben —
> 
> Samir sent the SAML metadata and gave a tentative staging window (Nov 29, 9–12 PST). Key follow-ups for our side before Friday:

Quick security constraints from infra/security: 
- SCIM endpoints must be protected by mTLS or token-based auth with short TTLs; we prefer mTLS for push provisioning. See attached scim-auth-spec.md.
- For staging we can accept 10.48.0.0/16 but production must be a public CIDR; no routable 10.x ranges for prod allowlist.
- Require SOC2 or equivalent attestation on file before broad production provisioning; Brightlane can provide a compliance contact or a link to a SOC2 report.
- Service accounts: prefer ephemeral vendor-managed keys. If Brightlane requires long-lived keys we need a documented exception (ticket to security) and key rotation schedule (max 30 days).

If Samir can confirm mTLS capability and provide prod CIDRs soon, we can keep Nov 29 as a staging dry-run.

—Neha Kapoor
Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@brightlane.com>
Date: Wed, Nov 24, 2027 at 09:30 AM
Subject: Re: SSO/SCIM + service account & IP guardrails — Brightlane onboarding

On Wed, Nov 23, 2027 at 01:14 PM Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick security constraints from infra/security: ...

Thanks — thumbs up on next steps, proposing the staging runbook below:

Staging runbook (Nov 29, 09:00–12:00 PST):
- 09:00 — Redwood: apply IdP metadata to staging tenant, validate SAML handshake with test user (priom+test).
- 09:30 — Brightlane: trigger SCIM push (ops@brightlane.com) to create sample users (10 accounts) in staging.
- 10:00 — Validate attribute mapping and group sync; log any mapping mismatches to the mutual action plan.
- 11:00 — Simulate token rotation for vendor-managed service account; verify fresh tokens succeed.
- 11:30 — Run failover test: deny IP and validate connection fails.

Ben — Engineering will prepare a checklist and playbook; I'll include token-rotation steps and mTLS handshake validation.

—Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Samir Khan <samir@brightlane.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri...@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Nov 24, 2027 at 04:45 PM
Subject: Re: SSO/SCIM + service account & IP guardrails — Brightlane onboarding

Folks —

Confirmed from Brightlane side:
- We can support mTLS for SCIM (ops@brightlane.com will send cert details).
- Prod CIDRs: 34.82.128.0/20, 52.23.64.0/22. Staging: 10.48.0.0/16 (will be NATed via our staging NAT).
- We prefer Redwood-managed ephemeral service accounts but can accept a short-lived vendor token during initial onboarding.
- SOC2: attaching a link to our compliance portal and will loop in security@brightlane.com for a formal copy.

Attaching: ip-allowlist.csv

Nov 29 window cleared — ops@brightlane.com will perform SCIM push at 09:30 PST. Let's keep the mutual action plan updated with any post-test exceptions.

—Samir
